name: General Video Intelligence
description: A neutral, cross-industry demonstration of local video search, investigation, and alerts.
demo_questions: Summarize the important activity in this video in chronological order.
When do people enter or leave the scene, and what are they doing?
Find the strongest visual evidence for any unusual activity.

verification_rules.prompt: Across these time-ordered frames, is a person clearly present in the monitored zone? Return only JSON. Set prediction_answer to YES or NO and reasoning to one concise evidence-based sentence.
verification_rules.system_prompt: You verify visible events from chronological camera frames. Return only one valid JSON object with keys prediction_answer and reasoning. prediction_answer must be exactly YES or NO.
